$comment: The engine release this repository is built and tested against (P17, CLAUDE.md §14).
Machine-readable so CI can build the sidecar image against the same pin that ships, rather than a checksum that lives only in a comment and a docs table.

This is not a fourth version pin. It is the checked-in form of the third one: what actually gets installed. OPENTAX_VERSION still says what a deployment intends to run, and data/opentax-nodes/<year>.json's engine.pinnedVersion still says what that node map was written against.

Two forms of the version, and they are not interchangeable: the download URL wants the release TAG (v2.0.4), while the binary reports 2.0.4 and that is what OPENTAX_VERSION is compared against. The app strips a leading v before comparing, so either form is accepted there.
Verified 2026-09-25 by downloading the asset and running it. Record every new pair here and in docs/opentax-draft-return.md §6 when the pin moves — see §7 for the whole upgrade procedure.
